items.title: Free Radial Sunburst Mandala Arched DXF Panel
items.description: A dramatic radial mandala expands outward in concentric rings of florals, striped rays, and geometric bands, capped with a Greek key border along the arched top and bottom edges. The sheer scale and layering of rings make this one of the most visually complex arched designs in the collection.
